name: log_report
description: Reads every svc-*.log in a directory and writes report.json keyed by file name with {errors, topCode, p95} (nearest-rank p95 of latency_ms; malformed lines ignored). Returns the report.
whenToUse: Whenever the daily log report must be (re)generated for a logs directory.

dir.description: Logs directory relative to project root

out.description: Output path relative to project root

provenance.reason: daily log report for 20+ service logs
